status_note: Flow-side no-return/inline wiring projection for CALLSPEC-NORETURN-WIRE-0001 slice (b): queryCall's queryFunction->setFuncdata->copyFlowEffects order with the !hasModel()||isInline() gate (flow.cc:660-664), checkForFlowModification's noreturn halt + warning (flow.cc:636-652), truncateIndirectJump's fail_callother setNoReturn(true) (flow.cc:747) with the mode now passed as the JumpTable RecoveryMode itself, and the copyFlowEffects one-way overwrite lifecycle. Byte-matches the locked oracle on all five cases with empty stderr on both sides.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: queryCall mutates the caller-owned FuncCallSpecs in place through the C++ reference and reads the callee FuncProto through otherfunc->getFuncProto() (a const path into the symbol database); truncateIndirectJump mutates the callspec returned by data.getCallSpecs(op) and passes the artificial halt to data.opDeadInsertAfter as an out-parameter-style insertion; Rugra mirrors both as in-place &mut FuncCallSpecs / dead-list insertion with no divergence in shared state.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: xref_control_flow walks the dead list forward so the halt inserted at the CALL index is xref'd on the next iteration (Ghidra --oiter at flow.cc:337); generateOps runs the addrlist fallthru loop, then hasInject()->injectPcode, then the jumptable do-while (flow.cc:785-817); specs and ops are projected in insertion / SeqNum order on both sides.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: no counters; the per-callee flags are a pure bit pair whose lifecycle is queryCall's gated one-way copyFlowEffects overwrite (clear-then-OR, fspec.cc:3806-3812) followed by checkForFlowModification's read; the artificial halt's halt-nibble is a pure flag OR.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: no sorts; the comparisons exercised are hasModel() (null model check, the flow.cc:663 gate), isInline() (the flow.cc:663 OR-arm), isNoReturn() (flow.cc:641), and the fail-mode equality arms of truncateIndirectJump (flow.cc:730/741/745) - all modeled as direct enum/bool equality on both sides.

cases: wireb_noret_user: queryCall (flow.cc:656-672) resolves the callee via queryFunction, and the !hasModel() gate (flow.cc:663) runs copyFlowEffects (flow.cc:664) so the callspec inherits the callee's no_return bit; checkForFlowModification (flow.cc:636-652) then dead-inserts an artificial PcodeOp::noreturn halt right after the CALL (halt nibble 0x1200000) and emits the non-inline 'Subroutine does not return' warning

wireb_inline_user: the callee (the function itself) is marked isInline, so queryCall's isInline() gate forces copyFlowEffects of the inline bit; checkForFlowModification queues the injectlist entry; injectPcode -> inlineSubFunction (flow.cc:1242) refuses the self-recursion ('Could not inline here', flow.cc:1256-1258) so the spec survives with inline=1 and the CALL op stays - the inline bit propagation without the unported inlineFlow clone machine
wireb_plain_user: an unmarked callee resolves through queryFunction but copyFlowEffects propagates clear bits - spec stays noret=0 inline=0, no halt, no warning (the channel does not invent bits)

truncate_fail_callother: hand-driven FlowInfo::truncateIndirectJump(op, JumpTable::fail_callother) (flow.cc:727-769) - BRANCHIND becomes CALLIND, setupCallindSpecs (flow.cc:736) establishes the spec, flow.cc:747 sets setNoReturn(true) on it, the 'Does not return' warning (flow.cc:748) fires, and a noreturn artificial halt is dead-inserted after the op (flow.cc:765-767)

copy_flow_effects_oneway: FuncCallSpecs lifecycle through the inherited FuncProto surface - set both bits, copyFlowEffects from a clean proto clears both (one-way clear-then-OR, fspec.cc:3806-3812), from {inline,noret} restores both, from {inline} alone yields {1,0}

wireb_noret_user.covers: queryCall queryFunction->setFuncdata->copyFlowEffects order (flow.cc:660-664) with the !hasModel() gate; checkForFlowModification's artificialHalt(NORETURN) + opDeadInsertAfter + non-inline warning (flow.cc:641-646)

wireb_inline_user.covers: queryCall's otherfunc->getFuncProto().isInline() OR-arm (flow.cc:663); checkForFlowModification's injectlist queueing (flow.cc:639-640); injectPcode's inlineSubFunction self-recursion refusal (flow.cc:1253-1258)

wireb_plain_user.covers: queryCall resolution of an unmarked callee; copyFlowEffects propagating clear bits; no halt / no warning when neither flag is set

truncate_fail_callother.covers: truncateIndirectJump fail_callother arm (flow.cc:745-750): CALLIND rewrite, setupCallindSpecs-established spec, setNoReturn(true), 'Does not return' warning, noreturn artificial halt; the recovery-loop mode now flows as the JumpTable::RecoveryMode itself (flow.cc:1445), fixing the old FailNormal-as-u8 mislanding in the fail_callother arm

copy_flow_effects_oneway.covers: FuncProto::copyFlowEffects one-way clear-then-OR subset overwrite (fspec.cc:3806-3812) through the FuncCallSpecs inherited surface (fspec.hh:1645), driven on a fresh callspec like the flow paths do

out_of_scope_observations.note: truncateIndirectJump's noParams arm (flow.cc:757-762) binds glb->defaultfp via setInternal plus input/output locks; Rugra keeps that arm as CALLSPEC-0001 (needs architecture default-model plumbing on the callspec), so hasModel is not projected for the truncate case. Owned by CALLSPEC-0001.
the default arm's fc->setBadJumpTable(true) (flow.cc:754) has no FuncCallSpecs field in Rugra yet; the fail_callother case projected here does not touch it. Owned by CALLSPEC-0001.
copyFlowEffects also copies the injectid (fspec.cc:3811); Rugra has no injection-id storage (INJECT-0001 stub), invisible here because the fixture callees carry no call-fixups. Owned by INJECT-0001.

the fixture feeds the per-callee FuncProto table through follow_flow_with_callee_protos, the channel standing in for Ghidra's symbol-database Funcdata funcp; the production data source (driver-side known-noreturn name list) is FLOW-NORETURN-DATA-0001. Until it lands, every production callee proto is absent and query_call copies nothing (curl output unchanged).

a successfully inlinable callee would exercise Funcdata::inlineFlow (funcdata.cc), which Rugra has not ported (inline_sub_function returns false at the clone TODO); the self-recursion case observes the bit propagation without reaching that machine. Owned by the inlineFlow roadmap item.

a Ghidra CALLIND spec's getName() is address-derived (fspec.cc ctor), while Rugra's setup_callind_specs seeds the spec's prototype from the caller's own funcp (carrying the caller function name) - a pre-existing setup_call_specs construction quirk documented at the callsite; name is not projected for the truncate case. Owned by CALLSPEC-0001.
